headline: Monterey County supervisors approve winery rules, ask staff to revisit venue-size limits
summary: MONTEREY COUNTY — A proposed limit on kitchen and dining space emerged as a key unresolved issue Sept. 29 as Monterey County supervisors approved new rules for winery-related development, ending years of work to put an existing county land-use plan into practice.
source: King City Rustler / South County Newspapers
